Class.comment: A mission class used for grouping missions into submenus

NameTarget.comment: The mission name as it will appear on the button on the SubjectTarget (the target of the mission).

NameCharacter.comment: The mission name as it will appear on the button on the SubjectCharacter (the character performing the mission).

iMissionTurns.comment: The number of turns the mission will take to complete.

iMissionTurnsScaled.comment: This value is multiplied by the year divisions and the result is added to iMissionTurns.

iCooldown.comment: Mission can only be conducted every X turns.

bBlockDiplomacy.comment: Diplomacy with the target is disabled while the mission is active.

bVisibleCharacter.comment: The mission button will appear on the SubjectCharacter.

bVisibleTarget.comment: The mission button will appear on the SubjectTarget.

bVisibleAlways.comment: The mission button will appear even when the subject requirements are not met.

bNoPopup.comment: Do not show a popup with the mission result.

bCharacterNoEvents.comment: The SubjectCharacter will be excluded from events while the mission is active.

bTargetNoEvents.comment: The SubjectTarget will be excluded from events while the mission is active.

bCharacterUs.comment: The SubjectCharacter must be of the player's nation.

bAllowSelf.comment: Allow the SubjectCharacter and SubjectTarget to be the same character.

bRequireContact.comment: Requires Contact with the other Player or Tribe.

bEncyclopedia.comment: This mission should give a tooltip hint with the shortcut to open the encyclopedia.

bRemindLeader.comment: This mission should trigger a reminder notification if the mission is available for the leader (missions for the leader do not send reminders by default as some, like abdicate, are always available).

bSubjectMapSelect.comment: This mission should toggle an overlay to select the subject target on the map (currently only supports units)

bShowReligionIcons.comment: The target character list will show the icons of their religion rather than their family

bShowCharacterSuccession.comment: The target character list will include the character's place in the line of succession

bShowCityDiscontent.comment: The target city list will show discontent level and rate

SubjectCharacterBonus.comment: Bonus that the subject character gets when the mission completes

MissionRoot.comment: Prerequisite mission that must be valid for this mission to also be valid.

GameOptionPrereq.comment: The game must have this option enabled for the mission to appear.

TechPrereq.comment: Tech required by the player to enable the mission.

OccurrencePrereq.comment: Occurrence must be active for the mission to be enabled.

Diplomacy.comment: The mission offers this type of diplomacy with the target (requires SubjectTarget to be a player).

SubjectCharacter.comment: The character subject who will perform the mission.

SubjectTarget.comment: The subject that will be the target of the mission. Does not have to be a character.

aiSubjectTargetCooldown.comment: Cooldown and duration that the subject target gets when the mission starts. Only valid for SUBJECTCLASS_UNIT targets.

aiResultDie.comment: The possible results of the mission, each with a weighting. Results are defined in MissionResult.xml.

aiYieldCost.comment: The cost the player pays to start this mission.

aiYieldCostOpinion.comment: The cost the player pays to start this mission, modified by the SubjectCharacter's opinion.

aeSubjectPlayerOn.comment: Subject requirement that must be met on the active player for the mission to appear.

aeSubjectPlayerEnabled.comment: Subject requirement that must be met on the active player for the mission to be enabled.

aeSubjectCharacterOn.comment: Subject requirements that must be met on the SubjectCharacter for the mission to appear.

aeSubjectCharacterOff.comment: Subject requirements that must not be met on the SubjectCharacter for the mission to appear.

aeSubjectCharacterEnabled.comment: Subject requirements that must be met on the SubjectCharacter for the mission to be enabled.

aeSubjectCharacterDisabled.comment: Subject requirements that must not be met on the SubjectCharacter for the mission to be enabled.

aeSubjectTargetOn.comment: Subject requirements that must be met on the SubjectTarget for the mission to appear.

aeSubjectTargetOff.comment: Subject requirements that must not be met on the SubjectTarget for the mission to appear.

aeSubjectTargetEnabled.comment: Subject requirements that must be met on the SubjectTarget for the mission to be enabled.

aeSubjectTargetDisabled.comment: Subject requirements that must not be met on the SubjectTarget for the mission to be enabled.

aeSubjectRelationOn.comment: Subject relation requirements between the SubjectTarget and SubjectCharacter that allow the mission to appear.

aeSubjectRelationOff.comment: Subject relation requirements between the SubjectTarget and SubjectCharacter that prevent the mission from appearing.

aeSubjectRelationEnabled.comment: Subject relation requirements between the SubjectTarget and SubjectCharacter for the mission to be enabled.

aeSubjectRelationDisabled.comment: Subject relation requirements between the SubjectTarget and SubjectCharacter for the mission to be disabled.
